
{{alias}}( x, dims, writable )
    Rotates an ndarray 180 degrees in the plane specified by two dimension
    indices.

    Each provided dimension index must reside on the interval
    [-ndims, ndims-1].

    The returned ndarray is a *view* of the input ndarray. Accordingly, writing
    to the original ndarray will mutate the returned ndarray and vice versa.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input array.

    dims: ArrayLikeObject<integer>
        Dimension indices defining the plane of rotation. Must contain exactly
        two unique dimension indices.

    writable: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether a returned ndarray should be writable. This
        parameter only applies to ndarray constructors which support read-only
        instances.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output array view.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ] )
    <ndarray>[ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ]
    > var y = {{alias}}( x, [ 0, 1 ], false )
    <ndarray>[ [ 4, 3 ], [ 2, 1 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
